description: This file defines functions and a helper class for replacing variables in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) within the ANGLE graphics project. It includes declarations for variable replacement functions and a class to track opaque variable re-typing during AST transformations.

classes.name: RetypeOpaqueVariablesHelper
classes.description: A helper class to track and manage the re-typing of opaque variables during AST transformations, supporting global variables, function parameters, and function call arguments.

methods.name: ReplaceVariable
methods.description: Replaces all references to a specific variable in the AST with references to another variable.

methods.name: ReplaceVariableWithTyped
methods.description: Replaces all references to a specific variable with a typed expression.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariable
methods.description: Tracks a global variable that has been replaced.

methods.name: getVariableReplacement
methods.description: Retrieves the replacement variable for a given original variable.

methods.name: visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Prepares to track replacements for function parameters.

methods.name: replaceFunctionParam
methods.description: Tracks a function parameter that has been replaced.

methods.name: getFunctionParamReplacement
methods.description: Retrieves the replacement for a function parameter.

methods.name: preVisitAggregate
methods.description: Prepares to track function call argument replacements.

methods.name: isInAggregate
methods.description: Checks if currently within a function call argument list.

methods.name: postVisitAggregate
methods.description: Finalizes tracking after visiting a function call argument list.

methods.name: replaceFunctionCallArg
methods.description: Tracks a function call argument that has been replaced.

methods.name: getFunctionCallArgReplacement
methods.description: Retrieves the replacement for a function call argument.

methods.name: convertFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Converts a function prototype based on variable replacements.

methods.name: convertASTFunction
methods.description: Converts an AST function node based on variable replacements.
